notes.title: [Announcement & Apology]
notes.notes:
Dear players,

As many of you are already aware, the full release of Realm of Ink has been delayed, with the new target window set for November 2025. We sincerely apologize to everyone who had been looking forward to the March release. That said, we are committed to making this delay worthwhile. The upcoming version will significantly surpass the original March plans, bringing more content, greater depth, and a more refined overall experience. In this letter, we’d like to provide a clear explanation of the delay and share what you can expect moving forward.

[h3]1. A Heartfelt Apology
[/h3]
First and foremost, we want to say sorry to every player who has supported us in the long time—especially those who were expecting the full version in March. We deeply understand your disappointment and frustration.

We also admit that our communication in the past three months has been insufficient. Due to a number of unexpected events—including the Steam takedown, internal adjustments, and new partnership negotiations, we failed to keep everyone updated in time. This information gap understandably led to confusion and concern in the community, and We feel truly sorry for this. 

[h3]2. Why We Chose to Delay
[/h3]
Our original plan was to launch the full version in March 2025, including four major chapters, the Book Spirit boss, and a fifth final chapter. By January, we had already completed around 70% of development.

However, on January 3rd, the game was suddenly removed from Steam, disrupting everything.

After two intense weeks of communication and appeals, we came to a hard truth: once delisted, it’s extremely difficult for a game to be restored or re-released in its original form. We began preparing for a new relaunch from scratch.

Some suggested we change the name and “rebrand” the game. But would that still be Realm of Ink? Seeing how the takedown affected our players was heartbreaking. After careful discussion, we made a commitment: we would rebuild a better, more expansive version, to repay your patience and support.

Then came another twist. On March 7, Steam unexpectedly restored our store page and put the game back online as it was. But by then, we had already started full development on the upgraded version. We decided to stick to that path and keep building forward.

[h3]3. New Rollout Plan: Three Phases
[/h3]
To let you experience the new content earlier, we will release the full version in three phases:
	•	June 2025 – Two new chapters + system updates
	•	September 2025 – Two more chapters + additional content
	•	November 2025 – Final content release + official full launch

These are not just milestones for our team, but promises to you.

[h3]4. What’s New in the Full Version?
[/h3]
We’re working hard to make the new Realm of Ink worthy of your wait. Here’s what you can expect:
	•	8 mainline chapters (up from 4), with 4 chapters randomly selected for each run.
	•	18 bosses in total (up from 9), including a hidden final boss with unique mechanics
	•	More enemies, systems, and build options to increase strategy and replayability
	•	Expanded build content and QoL features to boost creativity and ease of play
	•	A solid content foundation for future expansions and updates

Here’s a comparison table to help you see the difference at a glance:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/9c6a66fcc9cd9849069a21d267be1b7c9cfae671.png[/img]

[h3]5. To Everyone Still Waiting
[/h3]We know that a delay is more than a missed deadline. It brings doubt, disappointment, and uncertainty. We can’t ask for your forgiveness with just a simple “please understand.”

But what we can do is make it right—with time, with content, and with sincerity.
To everyone still waiting: thank you.

Your support is what gave us the courage to reject a “safe” release and instead aim for a version of Realm of Ink that you can truly love again.

Over the coming months, we’ll share updates more frequently, letting you follow the journey and growth of Realm of Ink alongside us.

We hope that when the full version finally arrives in November, you’ll feel that this wait was worth it.

With gratitude,
Leap Studio
April 9, 2025

notes.title: Beautiful painterly roguelike Realm of Ink adds new powers and perks
notes.notes:
If you're waiting for the next Hades 2 update and need something to scratch the itch, Realm of Ink might be just what you're looking for. The early access game takes very much after Supergiant's formula, and combines it with stunning artwork to render one of the prettiest action roguelikes you'll find on Steam. notes.title: Hades style roguelike Realm of Ink is even harder, and better, with new update
notes.notes:
I know it might feel like Steam is drowning in Hades-like games, but that just means we're spoiled for choice. Supergiant's roguelike was a landmark moment for the genre, and it seems like everyone has been trying to emulate that success ever since. To me, Realm of Ink is one of the few Hades-inspired games that comes close to that original greatness. Much like Hades 2, this painterly spin on the formula is currently in early access, so if you can pull yourself away from the latest update to Melinoë's adventure, Realm of Ink's new November patch makes the promising game even better.

notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Awakens,[/h2]
It's been some times since our last update, and we promise that we've been working hard towards what we have promised in the roadmap to v1.0. And now, please welcome and enjoy the Major November Update!

Watch the Major November Update trailer here: [previewyoutube=mqvE0_GS7_4;full][/previewyoutube]

- [b]New Ink Gem system: the Primordial Ink Gem.[/b] Offer the "Primordial Ink" Perk by sacrificing 2 Rare+ Ink Gems to receive the "Primordial Ink Gem". Each character form has a unique "Primordial Ink Gem" with exclusive effects and active skills.

- [b]New Special Perks: Boss Perks & Fragmented Perks.[/b]
Boss Perks: Each featuring exclusive effects tied to the specific boss.
Fragmented Perks: Collect fragments from the Foe Forge; combine four fragments to craft the "Deity Relic". 
Additionally, this update introduces new mighty Perks: 2 Legendary, 3 Epic and 3 Rare.

- [b]Jade Ink Store:[/b] Now , you can spend the excessive amount of Jade Ink you've collected during the runs in the Jade Ink Store. Spend a certain amount of Jade Ink at the Peach God's statue on the inn's first floor to unlock advanced features, and more reward refreshes.

- [b]New Difficulty Lv.6:[/b] Difficulty Lv.6: Wyrm Hair Brush Unlocked. Features increased enemies' stats, adjusted enemy layouts in the room, and enhanced mini-bosses attack mechanics.

- [b]Multi-languages:[/b] Languages including [b]Germany[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]French[/b], [b]Brazilian-Portuguese[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]Japanese[/b] will be updated into the game on [b]November 28th's patch update[/b]. Or you can join the dedicated language channel to discuss with others.

notes.title: Major October Early Access Update & Roadmap to v1.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Awaken,[/h2]

It's been a month since Realm of Ink Early Access launched and we hope you had or are having fun in Realm of Ink. After several minor patches, we are more than thrilled to put out our first major update in October!

In this update, we are bringing [b]3 new Ink Gem Powers, 21 new Perks, and a Pick System[/b] that lets players choose their starting Ink Gem Power and Perk. 

[h3][b]New Ink Gems[/b][/h3]
We have listened to the voices of our players who are eager to experience more of the essence of an Action-Roguelike, the thrilling hacking and slashing. Therefore, the new Ink Gems and Perks put a strong emphasis on the synergy between light and heavy attacks, as well as dashing and dodging. The aim is to enhance the action gameplay nature and maximize the satisfaction of every playstyle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/45f96bf65db7dd3a0130a672703578fe705fa379.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]New Perks[/b][/h3]
We have added a variety of new Perks ranging from rare to legendary. They also have a strong focus on strengthening the power of light and heavy attacks as well as dashes, further amplifying the experience when you use the new Ink Gems between runs. See below for details stats of the new Perks:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/75462b695d1be8c292850df998e085f4aa098daf.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Pick System[/b][/h3]
Once all endings are unlocked (after six successful runs), at the start of a run, you can choose one Ink Gem (only at the Common tier) and one Perk (ranging from Common to Epic tier) that you have encountered in previous runs. This will not replace the initial Ink Gem dropped in the first room, meaning you can equip two Ink Gems before entering any room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/0173c526724a457f90ffb5a15774268a8268fce1.png[/img]

With this update, the game now has: 
- 25 Ink Gem Powers
- 145 Perks
- 9 Weapon Forms
- 101 Martial Arts Skills
- Hundreds of Elixirs
The additional content deepens the game's strategic potential, encouraging players to experiment with new combinations and uncover unique builds.
[i](Please see the end for update details)[/i]

[h2]And it's finally time to reveal our [i][b]roadmap to v1.0[/b][/i]![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/837df80ae2f6bce126e8b232ab25e7de9545206e.jpg[/img]

Please note that our official v1.0 plan is different from the expected official version plan in May. The main reason is that based on EA feedback, we have decided to prioritize more resources to increase the depth of gameplay content and optimize gameplay. The plans for some new maps and weapons are considered to be launched in future as [b]FREE DLCs[/b].

With the roadmap being released, we hope to keep you coming back to enjoy more of our game by constant monthly updates, and to keep ourselves on the right track. Look forward to our full release!

Once again, thanks to all the support and feedback our player have given over the past month. And we can only show our appreciation by providing better and more exciting content for you!

See you in the Ink Realm!





[h2][b]Update Details[/b][/h2]
[b]Newly Added[/b]

Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that Realm of Ink will be launching a [b]Closed Technical Playtest[/b] soon. The primary objective of this Closed Technical Playtest is to conduct technical testing to ensure a stable and smooth gaming experience before the Early Access release. We sincerely invite you to join our testing team to help us identify and address any potential issues in the game.


[h2][b]Closed Technical Playtest Overview:[/b][/h2]
- Timing: The Closed Technical playtest will be conducted within a limited timeframe. The starting time of Closed Technical Playtest is estimated to be around the end of April.

- Participant Limit: In order to better control the testing environment and focus on resolving issues, we will be limiting the number of participants for the Closed Technical playtest. 

- Testing Focus: The Closed Technical playtest will focus on testing the game's technical performance, stability on different devices. Players will have the opportunity to experience the core content of the game and provide feedback.


[h2][b]How to Participate in the Closed Technical Playtest?[/b][/h2]
If you are interested in participating in the Closed Technical playtest for Realm of Ink, please access our store page and hit the "Request Access" Button.

- If you are selected to participate in the Closed Technical playtest, you will be receiving an email notification regarding being selected for the playtest from Steam official.

- The Closed Technical playtest will take place on Steam.

- No, participation in the Closed Technical Playtest is free of charge. You do not need to pay any fees.

- No, sharing of content or screenshots from the Closed Technical Playtest is not allowed during the Playtest period.

- No, recording, livestreaming, or publicly showcasing gameplay content is not allowed during the Closed Technical Playtest.


Once again, feel free to join our [url=discord.gg/X63T277eVn]Discord[/url] channel for feedback. It's crucial to us to receive your real-time and precious feedback so that we can fix any issue as soon as possible.

notes.title: Devlog#02 Updates on Our Progress
notes.notes:
Hi Awakens,

It's been a while since our last update, and we're thrilled to share some exciting progress with you all. Despite the silence after Steam Next Fest, rest assured, we've been hard at work behind the scenes, making significant strides towards our upcoming Early Access launch. So, without further ado, let's dive into some of the recent developments.
Please note that all the content shown below is still in development. [b]They do not represent the final quality of the game, nor will they be updated into the demo.[/b]

Firstly, we've made substantial headway in stage design and enemy development over the past month. With a plethora of enemy types to consider, we've decided to focus on discussing three stages that follow the fully developed first stage from the demo.

Watch the [b]Map Reveal Trailer here[/b].
[previewyoutube=5yqA1PSbWF8;full][/previewyoutube]

The "Animitta Mountain" stage offers a captivating blend of divinity and darkness. While the towering Buddha statues initially exude a sense of sacredness, closer inspection reveals a sinister undertone. Broken statues, extinguished incense, and scattered gold coins hint at a malevolent presence lurking within the mountain's depths. The stage's boss, "Monk Jin," embodies this duality, wielding weapons with monk-like serenity yet harboring a hidden darkness beneath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/d7491daafe351946b59aff9d53248f60268d6b37.jpg[/img]


Moving on to the "Eerie Garden," its ominous ambiance is palpable. Illuminated solely by eerie red lanterns, this stage sets the scene for a chilling encounter. Despite the lanterns traditionally symbolizing auspiciousness, their presence here adds to the foreboding atmosphere, warning players of the danger that lies ahead. The stage's boss, "Peony Demon: Keh," epitomizes this danger, her allure masking a malevolent intent waiting to be uncovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/ed5d56dccb418a9b2b02d8606065b2280bb33ddb.jpg[/img]


Last but not least, the "Mythic Graves" stage transports players to the ancient resting place of the Ink Gods. Giant skulls, burial objects, and the ever-burning lamp imbue the setting with an otherworldly aura. With the incorporation of Loong elements, such as statues and exit gates, players will unravel the mysteries hidden within these hallowed grounds. The stage's boss, "Dream Master," embodies the enigmatic nature of his illusion magic power, promising an unforgettable confrontation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/7b1f8d31d74d00e780072a2f8354e2b03840d2a9.jpg[/img]


In addition to stage development, we've also made significant updates to the "Fox Inn." From the welcoming entrance to the bustling dining area, every corner exudes charm and character. New NPCs and sets further enrich the inn's atmosphere, inviting players to explore its depths and uncover its secrets.


[b]The entrance:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/0da9060b99c1b1cc8ee77315313321c63d06d110.gif[/img]

[b]The counter:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/af5f7a7fb6c2dc6576e67b15b49dc0465818bd69.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/2d334d06f3b926a6cd7badcfdf645099b1ee3dce.gif[/img]


We've also been hard at work refining interactions between the player and our beloved companion, Momo the Ink Pet. We've introduced higher tier Momos with unique battle commands, these enhancements promise to elevate Momo's role in battles, providing players with exciting new strategies to master. Expect our adorable pet to showcase some of the coolest looks and abilities in the EA version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/c52c0610203c57673f8a408f431427782aa762ba.gif[/img]

We have plenty more to share with you, but we don't want to overwhelm you with too many updates at once. In the next devlog, we'll introduce updates for core gameplay elements like new Ink Gems, new weapon stances and abilities, and new special levels. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue our journey together!

notes.title: Devlog #1 the Ink Gems
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hello Awakens! [/h3][/b]

Currently, we are putting our main efforts into developing the content regarding Ink Gems, which is the core part of the 'Realm of Ink' gameplay. We are planning to design a total of 20 different Ink Gems, and for now, we have already made 5 Ink Gems, each of them is equally distinctive and powerful!

Despite you will be able to experience the Ink Gems in the very near Closed Playtest(if you have not registered, please check out our last Steam News for instructions on how to partake), we still can't stop the urge to reveal some of the Ink Gems contents to you, so you could have a better insight while participating in the playtest.

[b][h3]What are Ink Gems?[/h3][/b]
Ink Gems serves as the core build system within the game. Each Ink Gem possesses a unique mechanism, enhancing player attributes and altering the forms of techniques. Through the interplay of Ink Gems in Yin-Yang combinations, players can acquire a diverse array of skill synergies, forming their own distinctive builds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/117f1dcb372c7d99e3130f18a0f72c11fd7335d0.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Types of Ink Gems[/h3][/b]
There are various types of Ink Gems. Let's walk you through some of the most typical and powerful Ink Gems in the game.

Firstly, we have [b]Spike Ink[/b]. Its passive ability grants you bonus max health, damage reduction, and extra damage while attacking the enemies. 
And its active ability throws out a giant rock at your mouse's direction to deal damage to all enemies in range. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/26ee6da7e20fbc8c65fbcc19da0e025e294e97d1.gif[/img]

Next up is [b]Crack Ink[/b]. Its passive ability grants you bonus max health, and a shield based on your max health when you enter a new room. Also, your attack will be more powerful when your shield is stacked up. 
Its active ability puts down a magical circle, granting a shield with each second you stand inside, and deals a small amount of DoT(Damage over Time) to the enemies within.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/5190090bb98a944995d50ea1f2976837f7bc9335.gif[/img]

Last but not least, we have [b]Poison Ink[/b]. Its passive ability allows your light/heavy attack to apply Poison stacks to enemies(which passively deals DOT), and increases poison damage. 
Its active ability also puts down a magical circle which deals DOT each second, the enemies inside the circle take 2 stacks of Poison each second.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/399decb49456e3490b505c595807aa4351197e41.gif[/img]
These are just the tip of an iceberg; there will plenty more Ink Gems for you to explore in the Playtest version!

[b][h3]Ink Gems Interaction[/h3][/b]
Below, you can see what the Ink Gems interface looks like(you can view this interface in game by pressing V on keyboard or View button on controller, 'Share' button on PS controller), along with the descriptions of active/passive abilities of the two Ink Gems when equipped. The left Ink Gem's active ability is binded to Q on keyboard or LT/L2 on controller, while the right Ink Gem's is binded to E on keyboard or RT/R2 on controller. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/130806cfc1fb458497aeb20f2bf68935a9af7180.png[/img]

[b]Switching Ink Gems[/b]: When you hold two Ink Gems, and there is a third Ink Gems on the ground, you could press R or LB/L1 to replace the left Ink Gems, and F or RB/R1 to replace the right Ink Gems.

[b]Decomposing Ink Gems[/b]: You could hold on to the F key or RB/R1 for 3 seconds, and you could decompose the unwanted Ink Gems to get in-game currency '[b]Inkstone[/b]' which is for upgrading your Ink Gems. Even if you forget to decompose it, the system will automatically do it for you when you leave the Ink Gems room, so no Inkstone will be wasted! (The amount of Inkstone will not be deducted)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/4a0d61da1edff48798ea3e41850a37b386756672.png[/img]

[b][h3]Ink Gems Upgrade[/h3][/b]
Upgrading one Ink Gems requires 40 Inkstones, which is the same amount every Ink Gem you decompose will give.
Right before the mini boss or the boss room, there is a room where Qingyan(the Ink Gems Mentor, she is a mysterious fox that could unlock the full potential of your Ink Gems) and Jinchi(the Itinerant Merchant) are. You could upgrade one of your Ink Gem through Qingyan and it looks like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/4decd13b57dad7ee424ea27837ed16088742490a.png[/img]

You could see the comparison of stats of Ink Gems before and after upgrading, so you could decide which one fits better with your build with the upgrade:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720774/e2223868ad6581ecb2ca9ec3be3dd593a4fbd913.png[/img]
If you want more Inkstones, you could choose an Ink Gems room to beat and decompose the unwanted Ink Gem to get 40 Inkstones so you could upgrade the one you want the next time you meet Qingyan.


Ink Gems are the core part of the gameplay. The diversity and uniqueness of Ink Gems provide players with inspiration for constructing various styles, while the combinations of Ink Gems trigger chemical reactions, introducing a rich array of possibilities to the game.

There are many more aspects we'd like to introduce. We will see you in the next devlog!
